newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt state to auction rice mill.
newsitem.headline: Egypt state to auction rice mill.

text.p: The Egyptian state's Holding Company for Rice and Flour Mills on Tuesday offered a rice mill in the Nile Delta city of Mansoura for sale by auction as part of the government's privatisation programme.

In a published advertisement, the holding company said the mill could produce 96 tonnes of white rice daily. It said investors could visit the mill any day from March 3 to 27. The deadline for bids is March 30.

The state has sold part of its stake in several flour milling firms over the past 18 months but officials have often said the government will maintain control over the sector because of its "strategic" nature. Egypt subsidises its bread.
State-owned National Bank of Egypt is handling the sale.
